deadline.value: International applicants apply by February 28 for Fall entry (the only entry point); apply nine months ahead.
deadline.quote: Entry point for the PhD in Math and Stats is Fall (September). The application deadline is July 31 (domestic) and February 28 (international).

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the program page.

supervisor.value: A member of the department's graduate faculty must agree to be your advisor before you can be admitted.
supervisor.quote: In any event, a member of the department's graduate faculty must agree to act as an advisor to the student.

funding.value: Full-time thesis students without outside funding are typically fully funded through scholarships, TA and RA positions.
funding.quote: Full funding is typically provided for full-time, thesis-based students (who do not receive external funding) through a combination of scholarships, teaching assistantships, and/or research assistantships.

entry_route.value: A master's degree (minimum B, 73%) is required; direct entry from a bachelor's only in exceptional cases.
entry_route.quote: For the Doctoral program, a recognized master’s degree obtained with high academic standing is required, minimum B (73 per cent) admission average. The Departmental Graduate Program Committee will consider applications for direct entry to PhD with an undergraduate degree in exceptional cases

notes: Two streams: Applied Mathematics and Applied Statistics.
name: PhD in Mathematics & Statistics
